our_team_intro: The Experts Behind Your Automation Solutions. At Electrotech Automatisation Industrielle, our team is the driving force behind our success. With a shared passion for innovation, precision, and reliability, we work together to deliver top-quality electrical panel automation solutions to our clients.
our_team_charles_desc: With 30 years of experience in electrical automation, Charles leads our company with a commitment to excellence and cutting-edge technology.
our_team_isabelle_desc: Ensuring seamless project execution, Isabelle oversees our manufacturing processes and guarantees quality control at every stage.
our_team_designers: Electrical Designers – Experts in automation and control system design, ensuring each solution is optimized for performance and efficiency.
our_team_technicians: Technicians & Assemblers – Skilled professionals who build, wire, and test every panel with precision and attention to detail.
our_team_sales: Sales & Customer Support – Dedicated representatives who understand your needs and provide expert guidance on the best solutions.
our_team_managers: Project Managers – Ensuring smooth project execution from concept to completion, delivering on time and within budget.
our_team_commitment_desc: At Electrotech Automatisation Industrielle, we believe that great work comes from great people. Our team is dedicated to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction, making us a trusted partner in electrical panel automation.
our_team_join_desc: We’re always looking for passionate individuals to grow with us. Check out our Job Opportunities page to see current openings!
